Consider consulting with a financial advisor who can help you make informed decisions based on your goals and risk tolerance. They can also provide guidance on staying compliant with regulations.

Keep an eye on your investments and adjust your portfolio as needed. Regular monitoring helps you stay on top of performance and potential risks.

Always act ethically and legally. Insider trading is not only illegal but also unethical. It undermines trust in the financial markets and can lead to severe consequences.
